# Integrated first-pass software proof

`story-package.json` translates the revised portable script template's fictional
23-second courier example into three local action shots. It borrows the contract
shape from `../valid_shot_contract.json`, not the C50 narrative or media.

Tests construct tiny synthetic input images and simulated native output bytes in
a temporary project. Every semantic review and synchronized-AV review is a
clearly named **synthetic test attestation**. They prove factual gate behavior and
provenance plumbing, not image correctness, acting, lip sync, or model quality.
The subprocess transport and ffprobe boundary are mocked; real Grok/provider and
network requests must remain zero. No existing production media is used.

Entry and interior attempt IDs/output hashes are absent before those shots run.
The tests bind observed synthetic outgoing evidence only after generation and
selection. Completing these bindings under the unchanged approved story scope
must not require a second user-approval artifact. Changing a prior selection must
invalidate dependent continuity and final certification.
